title: ClawLoop: Self-Improving Agents via Harness-Native Training Loop
summary: Researchers introduce ClawLoop, a framework that enables harness-based LLM agents to self-improve without external teacher models through a continuous cycle of task synthesis, training, and diagnosis. The system generates and validates its own training tasks, updates the agent using SFT and RL, and refines subsequent iterations based on rollout behavior analysis. title: Correction Training for Diffusion Models
summary: Researchers introduce a correction training method for diffusion models that addresses error accumulation and exposure bias by training an explicit corrector on intermediate predictions. Additionally, the quality gains can be distilled back into the base model to eliminate extra inference-time overhead.

summary: The authors introduce MDN-VJEPA, a multimodal probabilistic Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture that models future states using a Gaussian mixture network to represent alternative futures, probabilities, and uncertainty. title: MRFlow: Mechanism-Structured Residual Flow Matching for Virtual Cell Perturbation Prediction
summary: MRFlow is a new mechanism-structured residual flow matching method designed for virtual cell perturbation prediction that models conditional transport between empirical single-cell measures. It decomposes the vector field into an affine dictionary for shared latent responses and a spectrally controlled residual field, integrating genetic graph convolutional networks and chemical Morgan fingerprints. title: PRIME: Frequency-Aware Unified Pruning and Merging for MoE Compression
summary: Researchers introduce PRIME, a unified optimization framework that combines pruning and merging for Mixture-of-Experts models through an Integer Linear Programming approach. title: DoSA: Dots Sparse Attention
summary: Researchers introduce DoSA (Dots Sparse Attention), a lossless method that makes sparse attention computation conditional to preserve exact token selection without scoring every key.
